t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Tse hu se re o ké ta kõ, tî Tôra to, tsa ta 'a se nya aha, ti tsa 'a 'ă na tsa 'a hyaã ma tia. Ta ke ē |kam a n ||'áu, ta ci o |hoa tsa kári |hoa ta ye o |hoa tsa ||'ai |hoa. Tôra ka ny:e h :ă tsàm se, Thõ ke hu 'a kwára kwe, |kûi se hk'òē kwe.
